why: We asked for the cost to win a family, what you keep from each $8, and the payback time, and none of it was answered. We also can't see how adding stores one chain at a time works outside your first market.
fix: Bring the unit economics: what it costs to win one family, what you keep from each $8 after the grocery side, and how many months until a family pays that back, using your real churn.
Show what it takes to add one grocery store, in time and money, and how Tidy works in a second country without starting over.
Show the cost to win a family with paid channels too, not only the waitlist that came from one newsletter post.

quotes.words: Cost to get a family, what is kept from each $8, and payback time: [not answered]
quotes.note: This is the question we care about most. With no answer, we can't tell if each family makes or loses money.
About a third gone in two months at $8 a month. Unless winning a family is very cheap, that payback won't work.
